description: Source code for a process management tool in a larger system, providing functionalities like listing, polling, logging, writing, sending keys, submitting, pasting, killing, clearing, and removing process sessions. It integrates with process supervision, session registry, and logging utilities.

classes.name: ProcessToolDefaults
classes.description: Configuration options for the process management tool, including cleanup time, cron tool presence, and scope key.

classes.name: WritableStdin
classes.description: Interface representing writable standard input with methods to write data, end input, and an optional destroyed flag.

methods.name: resolveLogSliceWindow
methods.description: Calculates effective log slice window parameters based on optional offset and limit.

methods.name: defaultTailNote
methods.description: Generates a note indicating tail output details if default tail is used and total lines exceed default tail lines.

methods.name: describeProcessTool
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the process management tool's capabilities and usage notes.

methods.name: createProcessTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns the process management agent tool with various process session operations.

methods.name: resolvePollWaitMs
methods.description: Converts a given value to a valid poll wait time in milliseconds, respecting maximum limits.

methods.name: failText
methods.description: Constructs a failed result object with a text message.

methods.name: recordPollRetrySuggestion
methods.description: Records a suggestion to retry polling based on session diagnostics and output activity.

methods.name: resetPollRetrySuggestion
methods.description: Resets the retry suggestion counter for a session.
